placement: Guardrail — the consumer-facing `limen verify` (cli/Limen.Core) and Limen's own repository guardrails (scripts/check-*.ts, tools/guardrails/**) read one engine-authority rule set, architecture/boundary-rules.json, which the CLI embeds at build time. An undeclared or empty boundary is an explicit `not-configured` verdict with its own exit code; a repository with no Limen boundary declares that with a rationale. Limen's self-verify derives its CLI version from package.json; the installed consumer workflow pins the CLI to the repository's recorded Limen version. Handwritten TypeScript outside the restricted subset and the federation engines/hosts come under the checks or carry owned, expiring exceptions.
